name: History (Min)

rules.name: Minor requirements

children.name: Six courses (at least five HISTORY), 18 units
Three of the six with a field or thematic focus
Two of the six in small-group format

rules.desc:
Candidates for the minor in history must complete six courses, at least three of which must have a field or thematic focus. Students completing the minor may choose to concentrate in such fields as African, American, Asian, British, European (medieval, early modern, or modern), Russian and East European history, comparative empires and cultures, or such thematic topics as the history of gender, the family, religion, technology, or revolution. Students may also petition to have a concentration of their design count toward the minor.

• Two of the six courses must be in small-group format (Stanford Introductory Seminars, Sources and Methods Seminars, departmental colloquia, and research seminars).

• At least five courses must be taken from the Stanford Department of History and carry the HISTORY designation or, alternately, be courses that the Stanford History Department has officially cross-listed. Transfer students and those who study abroad may be granted exemptions from this requirement at the discretion of the Director of Undergraduate Studies

• Advanced Placement credits do not fulfill any minor requirements.

• One Undergraduate Directed Research and Writing (HISTORY 299S) course may count toward the minor if taken for 3-5 units and a letter grade.

• Students may petition to include the 1-unit courses offered by the Stanford History Department (such as History 1: History of 2026) toward the required minimum 18-unit count.

rules.name: GPA of 2.0 (C) or higher in History courses

gpa: The student must maintain a grade point average (GPA) in History courses of 2.0 (C) or higher.
grading: Courses counting toward the minor must be taken for 3-5 units and a letter grade.
policies:
Petition Policy for Stanford Courses
A maximum of 5 units of history-related coursework taken outside of the department may be petitioned to count toward the minor. Transfer students and those who study abroad may be granted exemptions from this requirement at the discretion of the Director of Undergraduate Studies. Unless otherwise specified, all coursework requires a syllabus and petition form to be submitted to the History Department for review. Please see the History Department website for the relevant petition form. Transfer students should refer to the External Credit Policies for guidance regarding transferring coursework at their previous institution toward the Stanford degree.
transferPolicy:
The Department of History allows for transfer credits in a student’s course of study. A maximum of three transfer courses may be used toward the minor. All students should contact History’s student services officer to discuss their transferable coursework.
Unless otherwise specified, all coursework requires a syllabus, transcript, and petition form to be submitted to the History Department for review. Please see the History Department website for the relevant petition form.
Please review the additional Transfer Credit Policy from the Registrar’s Office.
reviewNotes: The audit checks six HISTORY courses and 18 units, each taken for 3-5 units and a letter grade, with at most one HISTORY 299S. Checked by hand: that three of the six share a field or thematic focus, that two are small-group courses, the 2.0 GPA in History courses, and petitions for a 1-unit History course or one outside course (at most 5 units). AP credit does not count, and at most three transfer courses may.
